author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
So you've got 100% crit with Wyrm's up, which is good.

You should be using Arisen Stonewarg, I think. Use Mimics, Gunnr and Wyrm's Song. Berserk if you need to - I'd probably only use them during long fights when you take the time to use Wyvern's too, but this build isn't really suited well to longer fights so get all the damage in that you can. Go between Rend Daggers and Channelalus. If you have a good +Atk proc up, don't waste any turns rebuffing DC, just keep using Daggers until it drops, otherwise prioritize having DC up. 

You don't have *that* much ward, but 50k isn't the worst. Try and let your follower regenerate ward for you, otherwise I personally found Ward of Light III to be a really helpful spell mid-way into DUrsa raiding. It gives you quite a bit of both ward and life, and can be exactly what you need at certain times. 

You'll do the most damage when you mana gets low, so try to play around that. If you only have enough mana for a Channelalus, give yourself mana first or you waste a turn of your T.All+++ drinking a potion. Sometimes you won't want to drink a super potion since it drops a bunch of your stats. You may end up wanting just 500 or so - it is really situational.

Ultimastrikes is also a great skill once you are about T11. It uses a ton more mana but can sometimes be better against certain bosses.
